categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: consumer electronics structural modules and related precision molds, focusing on R&D, design, production, and sales; and the photovoltaic (PV) industry, including high-efficiency PV module production, distributed PV power station investment and development, and EPC services for residential PV systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include high-temperature rapid molding, in-mold decoration, two-color injection molding, glass fiber molding, stamping and forging techniques, vacuum coating, automated assembly, CNC machining automation, and advanced inspection technologies. Production methods emphasize customized manufacturing based on customer orders, integrating mold design, manufacturing, and module assembly with automated and intelligent production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global notebook computer OEMs and ODMs such as Lianbao, Compal, Wistron, and Huaqin, serving leading notebook brands including Lenovo, Dell, Xiaomi, Acer, and HP. The PV segment serves global PV power station investors, developers, contractors, and distributors of distributed PV systems.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with manufacturing bases in Anhui, Jiangsu, and Chongqing, close to major notebook OEM clusters. It also has subsidiaries in the USA and Hong Kong to support international markets. PV business extends to Europe (Netherlands) and the USA with investment and manufacturing activities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream of the supply chain, specializing in manufacturing structural modules and precision molds for consumer electronics, and producing PV modules. It also engages downstream in PV power station investment, development, and EPC services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening expertise in notebook structural modules, expanding PV industry presence focusing on high-efficiency PV modules, integrated energy storage products, and distributed PV power stations. R&D focuses on advanced molding technologies, automation, intelligent manufacturing, and new material applications to enhance product quality and production efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of structural modules, precision molds, and PV modules. The company also earns income from PV power station sales, EPC contracts, and electricity generation. Sales are predominantly contract-based with major OEMs and PV project clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic providers of notebook structural modules, competing with firms like Juteng International, Victory Precision, Chunqiu Electronics, and Tongda Hongtai. It holds a strong position due to comprehensive service capabilities from mold design to module production and stable relationships with top-tier OEMs.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.48 billion, an 8.14% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 35 million, mainly due to initial investments in the PV segment. Total assets grew 18.13% to RMB 2.49 billion. The company is in a growth phase, expanding its PV business while stabilizing its core notebook module operations.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes rapid response to customer needs, comprehensive one-stop service from design to production, and advanced proprietary technologies ensuring high-quality, precision, and customization. Its geographic proximity to major OEMs enhances service efficiency. In PV, it leverages intelligent manufacturing and integrated solutions to provide high-performance, cost-effective products supporting sustainable energy goals.
